Hamilton County Sheriff’s Office

# News & Events

There’s always something happening in Hamilton County. At the Sheriff’s Office, we’re proud to keep our community constantly connected with reliable, relevant news and event information.

Start your research here, get answers to your questions, and explore the tools we’ve provided to get the information you need. If you’re confused, frustrated, or concerned by anything you see, please know that the Hamilton County Sheriff’s Office is here to assist further. Reach out at any time; your Sheriff’s department is working for you!
